decisions.reason: Actually compared current raw returned repair with exact original. The original face under the fedora and dark glasses is almost entirely black, with very limited warm light only at its extreme edge. The return still reveals broad yellow/brown face surfaces and a visible small mouth. Restore original deep black facial concealment over the whole central/right face, including mouth. Keep only the original narrow silhouette rim light, source hat/glasses, suit/tie and spotlight background. Do not brighten the face to show mascot features. Keep actual original hair, facial hair, clothes, accessories, illumination/crop and opaque restored background; a failed visual correction does not count as qualified.
